readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, Aurèle had each guest show him their watches (the dinner).
Played piquet until Dr Vauthier's watch showed a quarter to eleven, when he went out to the hall.
The temple struck ten while they were still at cards in the salon.
Dr Vauthier looked at the salon clock while the cards were still being played, after the temple struck ten; it showed five minutes to ten.

durations: Thirty years (Dr Vauthier has been at the Monniers' house as the family's physician and friend)
Two minutes (Dr Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the temple bell)
whereabouts: Dr Vauthier was at the Monniers' house tonight, invited to dine.
Dr Vauthier was at the dinner where Aurèle had each guest show their watches.
Dr Vauthier played piquet with Madame in the salon.
Dr Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat, leaving the salon at about a quarter to eleven.
Madame began to play the piano as Dr Vauthier went out.
Madame stopped playing the piano when Dr Vauthier came back.
Dr Vauthier and Madame went on with the cards after he returned, and were still at them when the temple struck ten.
Dr Vauthier has seen Monsieur Monnier's body.
Dr Vauthier attended Monsieur Jules Monnier in 1889, during his last illness.
